    Graded free presentations #

    grShift Γ d: A as a graded left module with shift d (degree g = A_{g d⁻¹}). GrPres μ: a free presentation with homogeneous generators zⱼ of degree dⱼ and relation rows homogeneous of degree eᵢ (Fᵢⱼ ∈ A_{eᵢ dⱼ⁻¹}). Every finite-dimensional graded module over a finite-dimensional graded algebra has one (GrPres.exists).
